_llm_instructions: Fill out the 'value' properties for each field in this Cost Estimates template based on the provided project context.

ID.guidance: Unique identifier, such as the WBS ID or activity ID

Resource.guidance: The resource (person, equipment, material) needed for the WBS deliverable

Labor costs.guidance: The costs associated with team or outsourced resources

Physical costs.guidance: Costs associated with material, equipment, supplies, or other physical resources

Reserve.guidance: Document contingency reserve amounts, if any

Estimate.guidance: The sum of the cost of labor, physical resources, and reserve costs

Basis of estimates.guidance: Information such as cost per pound, duration of the work, square feet, etc.

Method.guidance: The method used to estimate the cost, such as analogous, parametric, etc.

Assumptions/constraints.guidance: Assumptions used to estimate the cost, such as the length of time the resource will be needed

Confidence level.guidance: The degree of confidence in the estimate
